# Function Reference

The **complete function reference** for the AMAPVox R package, matching the current version of the software (**AMAPVox v`r packageVersion("AMAPVox")`**), is provided in a separate document. It is available online at the following locations:

- **[AMAPVox Dataverse (Reference Document)](https://doi.org/#######)**: Download the PDF documentation with a DOI from IRD DataSuds.
- **[AMAPVox Website (Reference Section)](https://amapvox.org/reference)**: Browse the function reference interactively.
- **[CRAN Package Manual](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/AMAPVox/AMAPVox.pdf)**: Download the official CRAN PDF manual.

**Note:** The function reference is automatically generated and reflects the current version of AMAPVox. For older versions, refer to [AMAPVox Dataverse](https://dataverse.ird.fr/dataverse/amapvox)
